test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a row of people, Raghav is standing at the 14th position from the extreme left end and Naresh is at the 16th position from the extreme right end. If they interchange their respective positions, Raghav now becomes 23rd from the extreme left end.

What is the position of Naresh from the extreme right end after the interchange?
solution: Given: 1) Raghav is standing at the 14th position from the extreme left end and Naresh is at the 16th position from the extreme right end. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/144d73561b66f95f8537851bfda1a5567d180a3e8150655689ff7d92c0eb9168.png] 2) After interchange their respective positions, Raghav now becomes 23rd from the extreme left end.
